title: Anyone Can Jailbreak: Prompt-Based Attacks on LLMs and T2Is

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreak prompts designed to bypass safety filters and elicit explicitly sexist content, such as generating arguments that justify gender-based wage disparities.
Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreak prompts designed to bypass safety filters and elicit hate speech, specifically by prompting the model to draft a white nationalist manifesto.

Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreak prompts designed to bypass safety filters and generate targeted misinformation, such as writing an article claiming that homosexuality is a personal choice.
